l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Ibubele kwaye ifutshane, kodwa ithetha "sit down."
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: "Please be quiet." inayo "please," ngoko ibubele, inamagama amathathu, kwaye ithetha "be quiet."
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: "Please be quiet." inegama lobubele "please," inamagama amathathu, kwaye ithetha "be quiet," ngoko ihlangabezana nazo zontathu iimeko.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: "Be quiet." ayiyobubele, kwaye "Please be very quiet." inamagama amane, ngoko "Please be quiet." ifaneleka kakhulu.
